meta.name: stitch-design-taste
meta.description: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成符合高级设计标准的 DESIGN.md 文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目建立严格、高质量的设计规范文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate DESIGN.md files enforcing premium UI standards for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish strict, high-quality design guidelines for your project

howto.what: Claude 会为你的项目生成一份 DESIGN.md 设计规范:写明配色(带十六进制值)、字体层级、组件样式、布局与动效规则,并列出禁止使用的 AI 套路,供 Google Stitch 生成界面时对照。
howto.when: 原文未写固定触发词。通常在你准备用 Google Stitch 生成页面、需要一份统一设计规范时接管;前提是能访问 labs.google/stitch,可选配 Stitch MCP Server。

say.text: 为我的项目生成一份 DESIGN.md,风格偏画廊式留白
say.note: 会按氛围、配色、字体等部分输出规范

say.text: 把这份设计规范改成高密度驾驶舱风格,密度调到 9
say.note: 会按密度分级改写字体与组件规则

say.text: 检查我的页面有没有踩 DESIGN.md 里的禁用项
say.note: 会对照禁用清单逐条指出问题

howto.what_en: Claude generates a DESIGN.md spec for your project: palette with hex codes, typography, component styles, layout and motion rules, and a banned-pattern list — written for Google Stitch screen generation.
howto.when_en: No fixed trigger words. It kicks in when you need a unified design spec before generating screens in Google Stitch; requires access to labs.google/stitch, optionally via MCP.

say_en.text: Generate a DESIGN.md for my project with a gallery-airy vibe
say_en.note: Outputs a spec covering atmosphere, color, type and more

say_en.text: Rewire this design spec to a high-density cockpit style, density 9
say_en.note: Rewrites type and component rules by density tier

say_en.text: Check my screens against the banned list in DESIGN.md
say_en.note: Points out each banned pattern it finds
